title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.32878v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-rank SVD-based compression offers a powerful strategy to reduce the computational costs of LLMs. However, existing methods face two key limitations: (i) global rank allocation, where uncalibrated error proxies fail to capture complex error propagation, and (ii) decomposition quality, where Fisher-based estimators suffer from severe rank collapse. In this work, we address these limitations by introducing Layer-wise Error Modeling Search (LEMS) and KFAC-SVD. LEMS advances rank allocation by introducing a layer-wise error surrogate that integrates local and global layer importance alongside a propagation bias, enabling effective global rank allocation via an ILP formulation. KFAC-SVD improves decomposition quality by utilizing token-wise statistics, mitigating the rank deficiency observed in prior Fisher-based SVD approaches. translated_title: 通过逐层误差模型搜索推进基于SVD的大语言模型压缩
translated_abstract: 基于低秩SVD的压缩为降低大语言模型（LLM）的计算成本提供了一种强大的策略。然而，现有方法面临两个关键局限：(i) 全局秩分配方面，未经校准的误差代理无法捕捉复杂的误差传播；(ii) 分解质量方面，基于Fisher的估计器存在严重的秩坍缩问题。在本工作中，我们通过引入逐层误差建模搜索（LEMS）和KFAC-SVD来解决这些局限。LEMS通过引入一个逐层误差代理来改进秩分配，该代理综合了局部与全局层重要性以及传播偏差，并通过整数线性规划（ILP）公式实现有效的全局秩分配。KFAC-SVD利用逐token统计量来提升分解质量，缓解了以往基于Fisher的SVD方法中观察到的秩不足问题。在Mistral、Qwen3和Llama 3模型家族上的实验表明，LEMS持续超越现有的搜索策略。
tldr: 提出LEMS逐层误差建模搜索和KFAC-SVD方法，通过融合局部与全局层重要性的误差代理实现更精确的全局秩分配，并利用逐token统计量提升SVD分解质量，从而有效改进大语言模型的低秩压缩效果。
